company_name: Fidelis Insurance Holdings Limited Common Shares
title: We are now Pelagos Insurance Capital
summary: Pelagos Insurance Capital, formerly Fidelis Insurance Group, is an expert capital allocator in specialty insurance and reinsurance, focused on underwriting expertise, partnerships, and disciplined capital allocation.
body_markdown:
Today we are proud to launch our new name and brand identity: **Pelagos Insurance Capital** , marking the next milestone in the evolution of our business.


While our name is changing, the fundamentals of the business remain the same: our team, our strategy, our underwriting expertise, and our commitment to clients and partners.


Watch CEO Dan Burrows introduce Pelagos Insurance Capital and share what this evolution means for the business.
